method.first: First process per scenario/variant, not cold disk. OS cache uncontrolled, warmed by build/prior scenarios.
method.cli: New Node processes, same exit-metrics preload; elapsed includes startup, RPC, formatting, stdout captured through exit. Alternating variant order.
method.metrics: Each CLI reports own process.resourceUsage at exit: CPU microseconds converted to ms; maxRSS KiB converted to bytes. No sampled heap peak.
method.fake: One fictional Unix socket server, authoritative parseRequest, fixed public fixture envelopes. Preencoded body, fresh correlated UUID prefix. No Store, runtime, SDK connection or WhatsApp.
method.raw: New process per scenario/variant. RPC time and CPU measured after imports; first + 10 sequential calls. RSS high-water includes imports and prior result hashing. No CLI formatting/stdout body.
method.limits: Fake transport isolates response assembly, not daemon/Store/network performance. All RAM effects are transient clients; persistent daemon RAM/disk/ingestion unchanged by this scope.
method.equivalence: Every CLI output and raw result SHA256 asserted across variants after removing only random RPC id; also compared with expected full/compact public fixture.
